source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.5 (PDF 269-271) in the book's order, with the corrections, our particle-family tree, Table 12.3 and a self-check.

blocks.text: Fundamental particle (bunyadi particle) woh hai jis ka koi internal structure (andar ki banawat) na ho, yani jisay mazeed toda na ja sake. Aaj matter (maadde) ke fundamental hisse quarks (protons, neutrons aur mesons quarks se bane hain) aur leptons (electrons, positrons aur neutrinos waghaira) mane jate hain. Yahi matter ke basic building blocks (bunyadi eentein) hain.

Jab nucleus ko bohat zyada energy wale particle accelerator mein toda jaye, ya do zyada energy wale particles takrayein, to bilkul naye qism ke particles bante hain jo aam matter ke atoms mein maujood nahi lagte. Yeh un zor daar takkaron (collisions) ka result hain jo matter ka basic structure jaanchne ke liye ki jati hain. Sau se zyada naye particles pehchane gaye aur milti julti properties wali families (khandanon) mein baante gaye. In mein se bohat se theoretical physicists ki scheme (nizam) mein theek baith gaye, aur baqi ko “strange particles” kaha gaya. Yeh hamesha pairs (joron) mein bante hain; maslan jab pion (π⁻) proton se takrata hai to do strange particles K⁰ aur Λ⁰ bante hain (kitab chhota k likhti hai):

Tamam particles apne axis (mehwar) par ghoomte (spin karte) hain, aur charged particles ka spin unhein nanhe magnets bana deta hai. Electrons, protons aur neutrons ka spin 1/2, photon ka 1 aur pions ka zero hai. Half (½) spin wale particles Pauli ke exclusion principle ko maante hain: ek qism ka sirf ek particle kisi ek quantum state mein reh sakta hai. Inhein “fermions” kehte hain. Zero ya whole number (poore adad) spin wale particles is principle ko nahi maante; yeh Bose-Einstein statistics ko follow karte hain aur “bosons” kehlate hain. Aage ki bari classification (darja bandi) yeh hai:

items: Nucleons aur un se bhaari particles jaise Λ⁰, jo decay ho kar nucleons bante hain, “baryons” (bhaari) kehlate hain.
Muons nucleons ke saath strong interaction nahi karte; inhein electrons, tau aur neutrinos ke saath leptons (halke, chhote) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab baryons ki misal mein Λ⁰ ke saath k⁰ (K⁰) bhi likhti hai. K⁰ (kaon) baryon nahi balke meson hai: yeh ek quark aur ek antiquark (d aur anti-s) se bana hai aur decay ho kar nucleon nahi banta. Kitab ka apna box (topic 12.8) bhi kaons ko mesons mein ginta hai. Is liye yahan baryon ki misal sirf Λ⁰ hai.

Dono qism ke β-decay (beta-minus aur beta-plus) is baat ka saboot hain ke protons aur neutrons fundamental particles nahi (in ke andar tabdeeli hoti hai). 1960s tak neutron aur proton jaise bohat se naye particles mile, aur bohat se “midsized” (darmiyane size ke) particles bhi jinhein mesons kaha gaya; in ke masses zyada tar nucleons se kam magar electron se zyada the (baad mein mile kuch mesons nucleons se bhaari hain). Strong attraction wale particles π meson ya pions kehlaye, aur kamzor (weak) interaction wale μ mesons ya muons (aaj muons ko leptons gina jata hai).
Is discovery se yeh result nikla ke yeh particles fundamental nahi ho sakte; yeh aur chhote hisson se bane hone chahiye, jinhein quarks ka naam diya gaya.

Particles ko un par lagne wali chaar fundamental forces ke hisaab se bhi baanta ja sakta hai. Gravity har particle par lagti hai magar sub-atomic level par is ka asar itna kam hai ke aam taur par isay ignore (nazar-andaz) kar dete hain. Electromagnetic force sab charged particles par lagti hai aur achhi tarah samjhi hui hai; zaroorat par isay shamil karte hain, magar is chapter mein zyada tar ignore karenge.

Bari classification is baat par hai ke particle strong force mehsoos karta hai ya nahi. Jo strong force mehsoos karte hain woh hadrons hain, aur jo nahi karte woh leptons. Hadrons ki misalein: protons, neutrons aur pions; leptons ki misalein: electrons aur neutrinos.

Hadrons composite (chhote hisson se bane) particles hain, jin ki do qismein hain: kuch bosons hain jinhein mesons kehte hain (maslan pion), aur kuch fermions hain jinhein baryons kehte hain (khaas misalein protons aur neutrons). Baryons odd (taaq: 1, 3, 5...) number ke quarks se bane hain (aam taur par teen), aur mesons even (juft: 2, 4...) number se (aam taur par do: ek quark aur ek antiquark).

blocks.alt: Tree (darakht) diagram: sab se oopar Particles; is se do branches (shakhein), Hadrons (strong force mehsoos karte hain) aur Leptons (strong force mehsoos nahi karte: electron, muon, tau aur un ke neutrinos). Hadrons ki do branches: Baryons (3 quarks: proton, neutron) aur Mesons (quark + antiquark: pion).
blocks.caption: Particles ki families: hadrons (baryons aur mesons) aur leptons (hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.text: Leptons sirf weak ya electromagnetic forces se interact karte (asar daalte) hain. Koi experiment ab tak leptons ke andar koi structure nahi dhoond saka; yeh sach mein fundamental particles lagte hain jo toote nahi ja sakte. Tamam leptons ka spin ½ hai, is liye sab fermions hain. Chhe maloom leptons teen pairs mein hain (Table 12.3). Har pair mein ek charged particle (e⁻, μ⁻, τ⁻), us ka neutrino, aur in ke anti-particles hain. Charged leptons doosre particles ke saath mil kar atoms aur positronium jaise composite particles banate hain, jabke neutrinos kisi cheez se mushkil se interact karte hain, is liye bohat kam (rarely) dekhe jate hain. Sab se mashhoor lepton electron hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab charged leptons ko '(e⁻, m⁻, t⁻)' likhti hai; m aur t printing ki ghalti hai. Sahi symbols muon ke liye μ⁻ aur tau ke liye τ⁻ hain. Isi tarah Table 12.3 mein muon neutrino 'νₘ' chhapa hai, sahi ν_μ hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko yun parhein: har family mein ek charged lepton (charge −1) aur us ka neutrino (charge 0) hai, aur har ek ka anti-particle ulte charge wala hai. Electron sab se halka (0.511 MeV/c²), muon taqreeban 207 guna aur tau taqreeban 3500 guna bhaari hai. Neutrinos ka mass bohat hi kam hai (1 eV, yani 10⁻⁶ MeV, se bhi kam); kitab ke sign '»' ka matlab yahan 'taqreeban/is se kam' samjhein.

blocks.prompt: Fermions aur bosons mein farq bataiye (short question 12.6). Meson boson hai ya fermion; wajah dijiye (constructed response 12.2).
blocks.explanation: Farq neeche table mein hai. Meson ek quark aur ek antiquark se bana hai, yani do spin-½ particles; in ke spins mil kar whole number (0 ya 1) dete hain, is liye meson boson hai.

items: Fundamental particle: koi internal structure nahi; quarks aur leptons. Zyada energy ki takkarein sau se zyada particles banati hain; strange particles pairs mein bante hain (π⁻ + p → K⁰ + Λ⁰).

Spin ½: fermions (Pauli exclusion); spin 0 ya 1: bosons (Bose-Einstein). Hadrons strong force mehsoos karte hain: baryons (3 quarks; p, n) aur mesons (quark + antiquark; pions). Leptons nahi karte: e, μ, τ aur un ke neutrinos (Table 12.3).
